name: multi-agent-shogun
description: Samurai-inspired multi-agent system for Claude Code. Orchestrate parallel AI tasks via tmux with shogun → karo → ashigaru hierarchy.

capability_evidence.remote-control: — you won't need to do it again.
capability_evidence.mobile-access: Transfer your private key to the phone, or use password authentication
capability_evidence.multi-agent-orchestration: Zero wait time — give your next order while tasks run in the background
capability_evidence.billing-metering: → Karo → Ashigaru chain of command prevents conflicts by design: clear ownership, dedicated files per agent, event-driven communication, no polling.
capability_evidence.session-persistence: ead of direct messaging between agents?
capability_evidence.memory-context: knowledge sharing through a four-layer context system:
capability_evidence.agent-runtime: ut, codex exec headless mode, per-model --model flag gpt-5.3-codex / gpt-5.3-codex-spark
capability_evidence.mcp-support: One command spawns 7 AI workers + 1 strategist executing in parallel
capability_evidence.voice-input: turing the thought before it disappears.
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor

friction.note_en: Some setup. install via npx one-liner, curl | sh installer; needs git clone (build from source), npm install/build; configure environment variables, API key configuration
friction.note_zh: 需要一些配置。可通过 npx one-liner、curl | sh installer 安装；需要 git clone (build from source)、npm install/build；需配置 environment variables、API key configuration

analysis.summary_en: Command your AI army like a feudal warlord.
highlights: Sonnet 4.6 as the new standard — SWE-bench 79.6%, only 1.2pp below Opus 4.6.
Agent self-watch + escalation (v3.2) — Each agent monitors its own inbox file with inotifywait (zero-polling, instant wake-up).
Separate rate limit — Spark runs on its own rate limit quota, independent of GPT-5.3-Codex.
OpenCode agent generation — scripts/build_instructions.sh generates .opencode/agents/*.md for Shogun, Karo, Ashigaru 1-7, and Gunshi from the same shared instruction source used by other CL…
